items.title: Kenny Burrell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Yeah, when we did the session and very dedicated guy. One of the most focused musicians I ever musicians, one of the most humble musicians I ever met. Always trying, always thinking about the music, practicing. No ego to speak of, I mean, he was about the music. And I learned a lot just being around him, just about focusing and dedication. A beautiful human being, and so, I don’t know if you ever met him, but he was a, there was a calmness about John Coltrane that you always, I always felt at ease with him. There…
Yeah, you had two different, no, you had two different sessions. One with you, Trane, Tommy Flanagan, Paul Chambers, Jimmy Cobb.
